sql: SELECT id, user_name, city, registered_at FROM users WHERE status = 'active';
SELECT id, product_name, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE status = 'active' AND stock_quantity < 20 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC;

SELECT DATE(paid_at) AS pay_date, COUNT(id) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv
FROM orders
WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  AND paid_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE(paid_at)
ORDER BY pay_date ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.user_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
GROUP BY u.id, u.user_name;

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name
ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC, product_id ASC;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
    GROUP BY p.product_name
    ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT product_name, sales_amount FROM product_sales;

SELECT DATE(registered_at) AS register_date, COUNT(id) AS new_users
FROM users
WHERE registered_at >= '2024-06-01' AND registered_at < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY DATE(registered_at)
ORDER BY register_date;

SELECT p.payment_method, SUM(p.paid_amount) AS paid_amount
FROM payments p
WHERE p.payment_status = 'success'
  AND p.paid_at >= '2024-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND p.paid_at < '2024-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY p.payment_method
ORDER BY paid_amount DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.user_name, COUNT(o.id) AS valid_order_count
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
GROUP BY u.id, u.user_name
HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2;

WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    c.id AS category_id,
    c.category_name,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.id 
      ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC, p.id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM categories c
  JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, p.id, p.product_name
)
SELECT 
  category_name,
  product_name,
  sales_amount
FROM product_sales
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY category_name;

SELECT 
    c.id AS coupon_id,
    c.coupon_code,
    COUNT(o.id) AS used_order_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS order_amount
FROM coupons c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.coupon_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
GROUP BY c.id, c.coupon_code;
SELECT id, user_id, order_status, created_at FROM orders WHERE paid_at IS NULL;

SELECT o.id AS order_id, r.refund_amount, o.total_amount, r.created_at AS refund_created_at
FROM orders o
JOIN refunds r ON o.id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  AND r.refund_status = 'approved';

SELECT event_name, COUNT(id) AS event_count
FROM user_events
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ue.user_id) AS user_count
FROM user_events ue
WHERE ue.event_name IN ('view_product', 'add_to_cart')
GROUP BY ue.user_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ue.event_name) = 2;

WITH user_base AS (
    SELECT 
        u.channel,
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS registered_users
    FROM users u
    GROUP BY u.channel
),
valid_order_users AS (
    SELECT 
        u.channel,
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS valid_order_users
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
    GROUP BY u.channel
)
SELECT 
    ub.channel,
    ub.registered_users,
    COALESCE(vou.valid_order_users, 0) AS valid_order_users,
    CASE 
        WHEN ub.registered_users > 0 
        THEN ROUND(COALESCE(vou.valid_order_users, 0) / ub.registered_users, 4) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS conversion_rate
FROM user_base ub
LEFT JOIN valid_order_users vou ON ub.channel = vou.channel;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS pay_month,
        total_amount
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND paid_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    pay_month,
    SUM(total_amount) AS gmv
FROM paid_orders
GROUP BY pay_month
ORDER BY pay_month;

SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_name;
SELECT id, order_status FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'pending';
